videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: What could be more idyllic than sailing down the Croation coastline on luxurious boats, sampling exquisite Mediterranean cuisine, sunning yourself on beautiful sandy beaches and delving into the local cultural heritage? Join host Vlatka Pokos as he explores Croatia's stunning islands, secret coves, dazzling Dalmatia, sensational Dubrovnik and on to exotic Kvarner in Istria. Along the way, enjoy diving in the stunning turquoise waters or just relaxing in the beauty of the natural surroundings.

videos.title: Inside Superyachts
videos.description: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world's most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders.

videos.title: America's Cup Insight
videos.description: Shot on location the signature series America's Cup Insight unfolds in six half-hour specials which carry viewers behind the scenes in voyage of discovery at the very heart of AC35. It's about the teams, the top pros, and the amazing new foiling technology. But beyond the sports side it's also about the inside story, the heroes, and the struggles to excel at the highest level.

videos.title: Kite Masters
videos.description: Kite Masters is a unique monthly magazine following the hottest Kiteboarding action from around the world, introducing the latest news from this spectacular and demanding sport. This exciting, fast, extreme, and stylish sport continues to take the world my storm, and Kite Masters showcases the best events and riders. We profile the movers and shakers, different disciplines and racetrack action from the top championships and world-tour series, as well as introducing the engaging personalities and passionate athletes competing in this thrilling arena.

videos.title: Tidal
videos.description: Tidal follows the journey of Lisa Beasley. After she suffered a horrible BASE jumping accident, she struggles to return to the ocean, but ends convincing herself to venture back into the water. Lisa's journey begins with a childhood love of water and sea life. Lucky of surviving the accident, she must now face an immense recovery period that brings her closer to her mother as well as her first love: the sea.As Lisa struggles to find an exercise she can handle, she starts discovering the beauty surrounding Cape Town's ocean. videos.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike
videos.description: Welcome to the 25th season of the UIM ABP Aquabike World Championship. The world's best jetski racers are once again looking for the UIM ABP World title in six categories: the Ski Division GP1, the Ski Ladies GP1, the Freestyle, the Runabout GP1 as well as the Ski GP Junior 3.3 and 3.2.They will prove their skills across different Grand Prixes around the world. The rider who gets the most points throughout the season will be crowned world champion.Get to know what to expect from this year's edition in this season preview.

videos.title: Salon Nautique Paris
videos.description: The Paris Boat Show is considered by the nautical industry one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public, this event is an absolute must, and we agree there is no other place like the Paris Nautic as France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the world. Thousands are expected to arrive on the 3rd of December until the following weekend, and fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles for the latest innovation and best deals. Are you going to miss it? Come join us, on Nautical Channel!

videos.title: What the Sea Gives me
videos.description: What The Sea Gives Me is a feature length documentary comprised of intimate & candid interviews with some of the ocean's most extraordinary ambassadors including Great White shark researcher Brett McBride, artist Matt Beard, photographer Chris Burkard, bodysurfer Angie Oschmann, conservationist Jean-Michelle Cousteau, free-diver Herbert Nitsch. We give you an honest and personal look through the eyes of those who thrive under the most extreme water conditions, those ensuring the proper care of the oceans for future generations and those who simply derive a sense of pure joy from the sea.

These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers

videos.title: Nautical Adventure in a Landlock Country
videos.description: Switzerland: home to the Alps and important water competitions like the Bol d'Or Mirabaud, the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Today it becomes the chosen scenario for this Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country. From extreme wakeboarding to canoe polo, we will discover that, despite being located far from the sea, Switzerland has a vibrant nautical scene.Get ready to accompany Nautical Channel's host, Lucia Metzbauer, as she goes wakeboarding with local Swiss pros, learns about the annual Match Race regatta, tries her hand at Stand-Up-Paddle, and discovers the little know

videos.title: Ocean Safari: Kenya
videos.description: In this episode, Andi arrives to the ancient Arabic town of Lamu. She is about to discover what dhow culture means to the people of Kenya. She spends three days with the incredible Ali Lamu, dhow builder and carpenter who is trying to save the lost art of dhow building. A unique experience will reveal many secrets of the location and this traditional work that is getting lost amongst younger people.

videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: What could be more idyllic than sailing down the Croation coastline on luxurious boats, sampling exquisite Mediterranean cuisine, sunning yourself on beautiful sandy beaches and delving into the local cultural heritage? Join host Vlatka Pokos as he explores Croatia's stunning islands, secret coves, dazzling Dalmatia, sensational Dubrovnik and on to exotic Kvarner in Istria. Along the way, enjoy diving in the stunning turquoise waters or just relaxing in the beauty of the natural surroundings.

videos.title: The Cyclades with Andi van Zyl
videos.description: Join our host, South African born Andi van Zyl, as she travels to the Cyclades group of Greek islands in the Aegean Sea. Located to the south-east of the mainland, the islands enjoy year-round sunshine and are home to some of Greece's most important archaelogical sites such as the bithplace of Apollo and the tomb of Homer. As well as savouring these ancient delights, Andi also revels in the abundance of beautiful beaches that are on offer and discovers the stunning blue and white stucco towns and fishing villages. videos.title: Kite Masters
videos.description: Kite Masters is a unique monthly magazine following the hottest Kiteboarding action from around the world, introducing the latest news from this spectacular and demanding sport. This exciting, fast, extreme, and stylish sport continues to take the world my storm, and Kite Masters showcases the best events and riders. We profile the movers and shakers, different disciplines and racetrack action from the top championships and world-tour series, as well as introducing the engaging personalities and passionate athletes competing in this thrilling arena.
